Who We Are

More than a nonprofit — a community built on love

Harmony Pagoda Organization was born from a simple belief: that warmth, art, good food, and genuine human connection are not luxuries — they are necessities. The name says it all. A pagoda is a place of peace, of shelter, of home. That is what we strive to be for every person we serve.

Founded and led by Tiffany McGinnis, MBA, Harmony Pagoda has operated entirely from the heart since 2022 — feeding the homeless, gifting toys to children, delivering handcrafted bear packages to seniors, and distributing hygiene supplies to those in need. No program too small. No person overlooked.

We are a fully registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit with a four-year track record of showing up, year after year, with our own hands and our own resources.

Four Years of Impact

Our story in the community

2022

Founded • First Homeless Food Drive

Harmony Pagoda Organization is established and receives its EIN. Within months, founder Tiffany McGinnis organizes the first annual food drive for unhoused residents of San Bernardino — distributing meals beginning at 10am until supplies last. The Thanksgiving Food Drive follows in November, starting at Perris Hill Park in Redlands and serving families in need.

Food Outreach • Founded
2023

Toy Drive at Lugonia Elementary School

Harmony Pagoda organizes a full-scale toy drive at Lugonia Elementary School in Redlands — filling two SUV loads with new toys including Disney Princess sets, Star Wars figures, RC trucks, board games, and science kits. Children and families from the school community receive gifts, with volunteers staffing tables outside the school office in the spirit of the season.

Children • Community Partnership
2024

Hygiene Outreach • Government Partnership

Harmony Pagoda distributes hygiene kits to unhoused individuals across the Inland Empire — each kit containing toothbrushes, toothpaste, soap, wipes, personal care items, and adult hygiene products. This outreach is conducted in partnership with the California Office of Community Partnerships and Strategic Communications, demonstrating Harmony Pagoda’s growing reach and credibility.

Homeless Outreach • Government Partnership
2025

100 Teddy Bears to Senior Residents • Christmas Eve

On December 24, 2025, Harmony Pagoda delivers 100 custom-packaged teddy bears to senior living residents in Highland, California. Each bear is individually gift-wrapped with a custom “Happy Holidays” shirt, a gold satin ribbon, and personal care items. For many residents, this was their only holiday gift — a moment of joy that defined everything Harmony Pagoda stands for.

Seniors • Holiday Gifting
2026+

Homeless Drive • Holiday Bear Drive • Arts Launch

November 2026 brings our fifth annual Homeless Outreach & Food Drive, distributing meals, hygiene kits, and supplies to unhoused residents across the Inland Empire. December returns our signature Holiday Teddy Bear Drive for senior residents — this year with an even bigger goal. We are also actively launching our Creative Arts for Elders program and seeking grant partnerships to grow every program we operate.

Active Planning • Seeking Funding
What We Do

Programs built around people

🧸

Senior Joy Initiative

Custom-packaged gifts, holiday bear drives, and personal care deliveries to senior living facilities across the Inland Empire. Bringing warmth and dignity to those who deserve it most.

Active • Since 2022
🍽️

Community Care & Feeding

Annual food drives, Thanksgiving outreach, and hygiene kit distribution for unhoused individuals in Redlands, Highland, and San Bernardino. Conducted in partnership with government agencies.

Active • Since 2022
🎁

Children’s Toy & Gift Drives

Annual toy drives serving children and families at local schools including Lugonia Elementary in Redlands. New toys, games, and educational kits distributed every holiday season.

Active • Since 2023
🎨

Creative Arts for Elders

Launching soon: weekly art workshops, creative gatherings, and expressive programming designed specifically for senior adults. Art as a tool for healing, connection, and joy.

Launching 2026
🏠

Dignified Elder Living (Vision)

Our long-term vision is a residential care space where seniors live with full dignity, comfort, and community — a true home. We are building toward this future one program at a time.
